description: exe.dev, a subscription service for fast persistent Linux cloud VMs for developers and coding agents, with a built-in web coding agent (Shelley).

name: freellmapi
description: Self-hostable MIT-licensed router that puts many free-tier LLM providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic failover.

name: gpt-oss
description: OpenAI's open-weight models gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b (Apache 2.0), often run locally.

name: llama-swap
description: Open-source proxy that fronts multiple local inference servers (llama.cpp, vLLM, etc.) behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, swapping models on demand.

name: llama.cpp
description: Open-source C/C++ LLM inference engine for GGUF models on CPU and GPU, including the llama-server OpenAI-compatible server; started by Georgi Gerganov.

name: llm-desktop-electron
description: Small open-source Electron app by mkornreich for running a Claude Desktop-style chat UI with non-Claude models (e.g. via OpenRouter).

name: tmux / zellij
description: Terminal multiplexers (tmux and Zellij) used to run and switch between many agent sessions in panes/windows that persist in the background.

name: yaac
description: Open-source tool by the commenter that auto-containerizes coding agents (gVisor containers) and provides inter-agent orchestration.
